name: Celebration & Event Microsite Production Themes
purpose: Original visual directions selected from the couple, culture, faith, venue, attire and available media. They are not fixed wedding templates.

themes.name: Romantic Editorial
themes.typographyAttitude: expressive serif with script used sparingly and a highly readable sans for utility text
themes.colourAttitude: blush, wine, champagne and warm neutral tones derived from the actual event palette
themes.surfaceAttitude: open photographic sections, soft dividers and limited decorative cards
themes.mediaAttitude: portrait-led with consistent colour grading and intimate detail photography

themes.name: Traditional Celebration
themes.typographyAttitude: formal display typography paired with clear contemporary utility text
themes.colourAttitude: jewel tones, metallic accents and neutrals derived from attire, textiles and ceremony materials
themes.surfaceAttitude: material-inspired sections, fine borders and pattern used as an accent rather than wallpaper
themes.mediaAttitude: traditional attire, family and ceremonial detail photography with respectful captions

themes.name: Luxury Minimal Celebration
themes.typographyAttitude: distinctive serif or restrained sans with measured display scale
themes.colourAttitude: small neutral palette with one material or botanical accent
themes.surfaceAttitude: large photography, generous whitespace, almost no card grids
themes.mediaAttitude: architectural venue photography, close portraits and deliberate negative space

themes.name: Modern Playful Celebration
themes.typographyAttitude: friendly contemporary type with one expressive display face
themes.colourAttitude: controlled multi-accent palette based on event stationery or décor
themes.surfaceAttitude: modular compositions, playful crops and selective illustration
themes.mediaAttitude: candid photography, motion clips and graphic details

themes.name: Faith-Centred Ceremony
themes.typographyAttitude: calm editorial type with highly legible scripture and ceremony text
themes.colourAttitude: soft neutrals and restrained ceremonial accents
themes.surfaceAttitude: clear hierarchy, quiet quotation sections and respectful use of symbolism
themes.mediaAttitude: couple, ceremony, family and place imagery with consent-aware captions
